headline: MSC Poesia Cleared After 11-Day USCG Hold
subheadline: Port state control detention at PortMiami
insight: USCG detained MSC Poesia at PortMiami on 1 Nov over deficiencies in onboard systems; a cruise was cancelled. Cleared 12 Nov. A reported oil probe is unconfirmed.

factCheck.notes: Detention corroborated: USCG statement (via gCaptain) says Sector Miami detained the Panama-flag MSC Poesia at PortMiami on 1 Nov 2026 during an expanded port state control examination; MSC called it a 'regulatory matter' and cancelled the 11-night Caribbean voyage (gCaptain, MSC via NBC). CBS says USCG identified deficiencies with systems on board; CBS and Cruise Hive say the ship was cleared to depart / departed Thursday 12 Nov. The criminal 'magic pipe' probe rests on one anonymous US official (CBS); USCG says it cannot comment on an ongoing PSC examination; MSC has not commented. It is labelled unconfirmed and never stated as fact. No charges reported.

meta.description: The U.S. Coast Guard detained the Panama-flagged cruise ship MSC Poesia at PortMiami on 1 November 2026 during an expanded port state control examination, after identifying deficiencies with systems on board; MSC Cruises called it a regulatory matter and cancelled an 11-night Caribbean voyage. The ship was cleared to depart on 12 November after about 11 days. CBS News reports, citing an unnamed US official, that the Coast Guard has opened a criminal probe into a possible illegal oil discharge; the Coast Guard has not commented and no charges have been reported.
